children: on Thursday warned of an annual operating loss of around £10 million ($13.49 million), reversing its prior outlook for a profit, as subdued demand and competitive pricing hit sales.

Crest Nicholson said its net open market sales rate fell to 0.35 over the last six weeks, down from 0.48 in the first half and 0.55 a year earlier, as UK housebuilders contend with affordability pressures and rising costs.
"While the trading backdrop has remained difficult through the summer, we are making tangible progress on the actions within our control" CEO Martyn Clark said in a statement.
The company had previously forecast an operating profit of between £5m and £10m for the fiscal year ending in October 2026.
